keywords.indexterm: intelligent variable transmission (IVT) shift lock override

section.p: If you cannot move the shift lever from P (Park) to R (Reverse) with the brake pedal engaged, continue to engage the brake, then perform the following actions:

li.p: Start the vehicle from the LOCK or OFF position.
Carefully remove the cap (1) covering the shift-lock release access hole.
Insert a tool (such as a flathead screwdriver) into the access hole and press down on the tool.
Remove the tool from the shift lock override access hole, then replace the cap.

section.p: If the shift lever does not move even after you perform this procedure, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
